dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at this! My dance video went viral!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət ˈðɪs! maɪ ˈdæns ˌvɪdioʊ ˈwɛnt ˈvaɪrəl!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? How many people have watched it?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl hæv ˈwɑːtʃt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: More than a million. Now everyone is doing the dance. It's a trend!
dialogue.reading: ˈmɔːr ðən ə ˈmɪljən. ˈnaʊ ˈɛvriwʌn ɪz ˈduːɪŋ ðə ˈdæns. ɪts ə ˈtrɛnd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Amazing! How long did you spend making it?
dialogue.reading: əˈmeɪzɪŋ! ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ dɪd juː ˈspɛnd ˈmeɪkɪŋ ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Only ten minutes. But I've spent all morning reading the comments.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts. bʌt aɪv ˈspɛnt ˈɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ˈriːdɪŋ ðə ˈkɑːmɛnts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't waste time reading them. Some people write terrible things.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈweɪst ˈtaɪm ˈriːdɪŋ ðɛm. sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈraɪt ˈtɛrəbəl ˈθɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. So what do you do online, Nam?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. soʊ ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I spend hours watching livestreams from night markets. The sellers are so funny!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈspɛnd ˈaʊərz ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ ˈlaɪvstriːmz frəm ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪts. ðə ˈsɛlərz ər ˈsoʊ ˈfʌni!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. And I subscribe to three cooking channels. I watch them every evening.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ənd aɪ səbˈskraɪb tə ˈθriː ˈkʊkɪŋ ˌtʃænəlz. aɪ ˈwɑːtʃ ðɛm ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Every evening? You should spend more time cooking and less time watching!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ? juː ʃʊd ˈspɛnd ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm ˈkʊkɪŋ ənd ˈlɛs ˈtaɪm ˈwɑːtʃɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ha! Maybe you're right. Let's cook something together tonight.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ˈmeɪbi jʊr ˈraɪt. lɛts ˈkʊk ˈsʌmθɪŋ təˈɡɛðər təˈnaɪt.
